title: SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.06953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illu

translated_title: SteelAgent：由大语言模型编排、融合物理信息的钢性能预测，具备可审计的泛化能力与经校准的不确定性
translated_abstract: 钢性能模型在随机测试集划分上可能表现良好，即使其对陌生合金的外推能力很差。SteelAgent 将冶金学描述符与机器学习模型和语言模型接口相结合，用于性能预测、不确定性报告和逆向设计。我们研究了留出单元的选择如何改变基于 SteelBench 抗拉强度评估所得出的结论。对于梯度提升模型，合并的折外 R² 从随机划分下的 0.859 下降到留出钢族时的 0.113。名义 90% 预测区间的经验覆盖率从随机划分下的 91.0% 变化到留出数据源时的 37.6%。物理衍生特征的效果取决于评估方式：在 17 个钢族的留出分析中，它们使梯度提升的 R² 提高了 0.2534，而在另一项针对四个牌号的实验室分析中，却使其降低了 0.358。我们报告了组级误差以及一项合成回归实验的结…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SteelAgent 将大语言模型编排、冶金描述符与机器学习相结合用于钢性能预测，并揭示评估时留出单元的选择会彻底改变结论——随机划分下表现优异的模型在留出陌生钢族或数据源时性能骤降且不确定性校准失效。
en_tdlr: SteelAgent couples LLM orchestration, metallurgical descriptors, and machine learning for steel property prediction, showing that the choice of held-out split drastically changes conclusions—models that excel on random splits collapse and exhibit miscalibrated uncertainty when generalizing to unseen steel families or sources.
